checkpoints.description: [1/2] Align bank used-amount stat with card-limit basis

impact_assessment.why: Vision review found the bank card-limit stat mixing card and loan debt (108.450₺) next to a card-based 23.7% utilization figure, an internally contradictory display (G-003 functional/usable).
impact_assessment.benefits: Used-amount stat now shows card debt only (28.450₺), consistent with utilization and available limit; loans remain in the separate breakdown; failing-first test added; vision reviews approved (94 -> 97).
impact_assessment.risks: One render expression changed plus a test; no data model changes; banks without loans unaffected; 109/109 tests pass.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first test confirmed 1 failure before fix, then 109/109 pass; ui verify + ui finish --reviewed; vision analysis; check --strict 4/4.
